about.disclaimerShort: Not financial advice. Signals mark things worth researching, not buy calls.
about.what: Bottom Tracker checks your watchlist every weekday night and gives each stock a Bottom Score: how many signals suggest it may be near a long-term bottom. Every score shows exactly which signals fired and why.
about.disclaimer: This is a personal research tool. It is not financial advice and never places orders. A high score means "worth researching", not "buy". Stocks can stay cheap for a long time.
about.privacy: Your watchlist and scores are stored privately: only your account can read them.

mfa.title: Two-step login
mfa.off: Off: set it up before entering your portfolio
mfa.why: After your password, the app also asks a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on your phone. Your portfolio can only be opened this way.
mfa.step1: Open an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…).
mfa.step2: Scan the QR code, or type the secret below into the app.
mfa.step3: Type the 6-digit code the app shows and tap Turn on.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
mfa.codeBody: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for Bottom Tracker.
mfa.wrong: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds: try the newest one.
mfa.sixDigits: Type the 6 digits from the app.

pf.mfaBody: Your portfolio is personal money data. It can only be opened after a second step: a code from an authenticator app.

risk.title: Risk rules
risk.menuHint: Your limits for the sizing calculator
risk.profileHint: Sets all numbers below. Changing a number makes it Custom.

h.risk_per_position: How much of your whole portfolio you accept losing on one position in a bad year.
h.k: Bad-case drop = k × annual volatility. 1,5 ≈ a bad year.
h.satellite_max: Single stocks and sector ETFs together.
h.speculative_max: Small caps, speculative stocks and crypto together.
h.type_caps_stock_quality: One stock with a high quality score.
h.type_caps_stock: One stock with a lower or unknown quality score.
h.sector_max: Stocks + sector ETFs in one sector.
h.region_max: Stocks + sector ETFs in one region.

risk.previewNone: Add a stock to your portfolio to see what the rules mean in euros.
risk.splitInvalid: Core at least + satellite at most can't be more than 100 %.
risk.logNote: Every change is saved with the date, so the yearly review shows when your rules changed.

imp.title: Import from Bolero
imp.lead: Bring your Bolero positions in without typing them. Each position becomes a starting position with your average purchase price.
imp.howTitle: How do I export from Bolero?
imp.how2: If Bolero lets you, switch on the ISIN column (column settings). Without it the app matches on name and market, and you check each row.
imp.how3: Tap the Excel icon and choose that file here.
imp.privacy: The file is read on this device and never uploaded or kept. Only ISIN, name and market are used to find the tickers; only ticker, quantity, average price, currency and type are saved.
imp.noIsinTitle: No ISIN column in this file
imp.noIsinBody: Tickers are matched on Bolero's names and markets. Each suggestion shows Yahoo's name, exchange and currency: check that they match before you import.
imp.lookupFailed: Couldn't look up the tickers. Type them in yourself.
imp.suggested: Suggested: check it's the right exchange.
imp.checkTicker: Check the ticker: no match found. Type it to include this row.
imp.cashHint: From the Cash row in the file.
imp.replaceHint: Removes the positions from your last import first, so nothing is counted twice. Trades you added yourself stay.
imp.badTicker: {name}: type a valid ticker or untick the row.
imp.noPrice: {name}: no average purchase price in the file.
imp.notBolero: This isn't a Bolero position overview. Export it from Portefeuille → Posities.
imp.nameDiffers: The names differ: check it's the same fund or company.
imp.otherCurrency: Listed in {cur}, your Bolero position is in {file}: probably another exchange.
imp.noPrices: Yahoo has no prices for {symbol}. Check the ticker (the exchange suffix, e.g. .DE, .AS, .PA).

risk3.title: Risk check
risk3.togetherWarn: {list} move together (correlation above 0,8): a bad day hits all of them.
risk3.togetherBody: From 1 year of daily returns. Can I buy this? lowers the amount for stocks that move with what you own.
risk3.togetherNone: None of your holdings move closely together. Good spread.
risk3.proxyNote: {list}: no history that far back, the S&P 500 (or a bond ETF) is used instead.
risk3.stressNote: Each holding's real move in that period, cash counted as 0 %. Not a forecast: the next crisis will look different.
